Cost: 150eb (Premium)

“Snagged some reactive plates off the Net — same stuff they bolt to panzers, go figure.”

- Rogue Amendiares

SP12 or lower Body Armor Attachment. Installing this requires a DV17 Basic Tech Skill Check, and cannot be removed once installed. Only one Reactive Armor Panels may be installed at a time. The armor’s SP is increased by 1, but the next time its SP is ablated by 1 or more SP, this attachment is immediately uninstalled and Destroyed Beyond Repair. The armor then returns to its pre-attachment maximum SP (e.g., SP 11 becomes SP 12 until the next time it’s ablated, and then returns to SP 11). This attachment cannot be Tech Upgraded to provide additional SP.

Type: Armor Attachment (Body Armor, SP 12 or lower)
Attachment slots: 0

Foundry notes:

  • Armor Enhancement rules: one Enhancement per piece of armor (armor worn on both body and head counts as one piece); not for cyberware armor (Skinweave, Subdermal Armor) or armor that's part of an ACPA or vehicle; SP limits use the armor's fully repaired SP; a Tech installs or removes one in 1 hour with no check; they don't count as Tech Upgrades for Upgrade Expertise. Armor Attachments have no limit per armor unless stated.
  • +1 SP (automated) until the armor is next ablated.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Armor & Fashion > Armor Enhancements & Kits).
